title: MeetingOccurrence
description: A meeting occurrence on the hosted store (decision 10), keyed by Daybreak's event key: the calendar UID plus the original occurrence start. meetingID is safe in a URL path (a hash of the key is fine); the raw eventKey is always in the body. Other calendar identifiers are aliases, never the only key: event ids change on calendar moves and local ids can be lost on a full sync (Codex contracts.md).

owner.description: The owner namespace, an opaque ref.

revision.description: Bumped on every edit; writes carry expectedRevision and a stale one is a conflict.

start.description: Scheduled start. Actual capture times live on the capture session.

alias.title: MeetingAlias
alias.description: One identifier another system uses for this occurrence. Unrelated accounts are never merged by title or URL.

kind.description: uid: the iCalendar UID; event: the provider's event id; series: the recurring series id; row: a device's calendar row; note-folder: Daybreak's StableID note folder.

account.description: An opaque account ref, never an email.

originalStart.description: For a recurring instance: the occurrence's original start, which stays when it's moved.

local.description: Only meaningful on one device; never use it to match across devices.
